title: Quick Crunchy Portuguese Shrimp Skewers
description: A sour and crunchy Portuguese dish featuring cayenne pepper, this recipe is perfect for those looking for an adventurous meal, and its use of turmeric and ginger makes it anti-inflammatory friendly. The shrimp are marinated in a brine solution before being grilled to perfection.
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat.
In a large bowl, whisk together lemon juice, olive oil, garlic, salt, black pepper, paprika, cayenne pepper, turmeric, and ginger.
Add the shrimp to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Let the shrimp marinate for at least 10 minutes.
Thread the marinated shrimp onto skewers.
Grill the shrimp for 2-3 minutes per side, or until they are pink and cooked through.
Transfer the skewers to a terracotta dish and serve immediately.
Garnish with lemon wedges and chopped fresh parsley, if desired.
Serve with a side of quinoa or rice to round out the meal.
